name: empire-youtube-intelligence
description: Research public YouTube videos and plan original, evidence-based business content with Empire AI.

interface.shortDescription: Research YouTube videos and plan evidence-led content.
interface.longDescription: Check public video information, distinguish observed facts from assumptions, and plan original videos for business audiences. Preview does not provide private competitor analytics or publish videos.
defaultPrompt: Review the public metadata for this YouTube video and suggest three original content angles.
Help me plan an evidence-led YouTube video without inventing metrics.
